**Daily Devotional**

**April 21**

*21 For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain. 22 But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not. 23 For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better: (Philippians 1:21-23 KJV)*

These verses show why Paul was such a dedicated Apostle, as he was dead to himself and for him to live was Christ living through him. He actually looked forward to his death so that he might be with Christ, which he considered to be much better. All Christians should feel this way, as it is a fact (Romans 8:18). He wrote these verses while he was in a Roman prison, facing possible death. That is why he says that if he lives in the flesh, his lot would be to suffer and be in prison, but he chooses what the Lord would have him do, and not what he would prefer to do.

Those who fear death are living in unnecessary bondage (Hebrews 2:15). If the Christian would think on Heaven, and the things that God has prepared for His children, we would know that we can not lose for winning. If we live, we live for Christ, and to do His calling in this world, but if we die, we get to go to be with Him, which is even better (John 14:2-3). We should continually praise God for all the blessings He has given us, that we can have eternal life now (John 17:3), not just when we get to Heaven. If you truly have a strong, knowing, kind of faith, you will not have any fear of death. Thank you Lord!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
